Black Friday 2027 remains rule-derived as Friday Nov 26 from OPM's official Thanksgiving Day 2027 date of Thursday Nov 25; Cyber Monday Nov 29 is a calendar-derived comparison checkpoint, not a guaranteed cheaper-sale date. No live 2027 retailer prices, stock, launch times or future laptop claims are asserted. The browser-local exact-series ledger separates a 90-day shopper research history from the Germany/EU prior-price concept based on the lowest price applied in at least the previous 30 days; personal sparse observations are not represented as a legal compliance finding or market-wide historical low. The JavaScript 90-day and 30-day pre-Black-Friday windows both end Nov 25 so the Nov 26 price cannot become its own prior baseline. Historical 2025 EU sweep findings (314 traders; at least 30% referenced discounts incorrectly) are labelled historical rather than predictive. A gaming-laptop comparator requires exact SKU plus CPU, GPU, published GPU power/TGP when available, VRAM, RAM, storage, display, condition, warranty and landed price; same GPU family is explicitly not treated as system equivalence or performance proof. UK price-transparency evidence includes mandatory delivery and other unavoidable charges plus the CMA's Nov 2 2026 retailer reminder. U.S. deceptive former-price/FTC shopping guidance, Canadian ordinary-selling-price volume/time tests, Australian total-price and consumer-guarantee boundaries, UK distance returns and Germany/EU distance withdrawal remain jurisdiction-specific. BF-vs-CM comparisons stay inside one exact SKU/seller/market/condition/currency series. This replaces the older four-source approval scope; the hub was already present in the approval registry, so registry count remains unchanged.

SXSW Conferences & Festivals are confirmed for Mar 15–21, 2027 in Austin; Conference Mar 15–20, Music and Film & TV Mar 15–21, Comedy Mar 17–20. Registration is open. Current Nov 6 cart snapshot: Platinum $1,495, Innovation $995, Film & TV $850, Music $625; prices may change and stale Oct 29 savings copy is preserved as a source conflict. Reservations open Mar 9 (Platinum 11am CT; all badges 2pm CT) with 3/day Platinum and 2/day core vertical badges; Mar 14 expands non-conflicting Film screening reservations. Credentials do not guarantee admission. 340+ PanelPicker sessions and first keynote/featured sessions are announced while Film & TV title lineup remains pending. 2027 clubhouses, Film venues, housing/travel guidance and Feb 27 accessibility deadline are sourced. Tools use user-entered transfer/queue buffers and localStorage; no session, speaker, artist, screening, walking time, inventory or availability is fabricated.

The dedicated 2027 page describes 17 content tracks plus Centre Stage and general-ticket access to talks, masterclasses, roundtables, curated meetups, exhibition, Night Summit, partner perks and the mobile app. A current 2027 2-for-1 page advertises two tickets for €950 total with no verified expiry date; this is not converted into a €475 standalone-ticket claim. The 2027 page still links to the 2026 schedule, so no 2027 speakers, stage times or complete venue footprint are asserted. Startup applications are open for 2027; current organizer guidance says successful startup applicants receive three tickets and uses an ALPHA/BETA/GROWTH selection framework, but acceptance and exact 2027 package price/deadlines remain discretionary/pending. Lisbon 2027 investor-ticket price/availability and 2027 online/replay access remain unverified. MEO Arena and Lisbon Metro provide a current Oriente/Red-line/airport baseline, while 2026 event shuttles, registration hours and other event-specific travel details are not carried forward. Browser-local tools cover agenda conflicts, access-path comparison, startup framework fit, user-buffered transit planning and networking evidence.

Black Friday 2026 is treated as a rule-derived retail date: OPM confirms U.S. Thanksgiving on Thursday Nov 26, 2026, so this hub uses Friday Nov 27 as the conventional Black Friday date and Monday Nov 30 as a calendar-derived Cyber Monday comparison checkpoint; neither is represented as an OPM-designated federal holiday or universal retailer sale window. The hub does not scrape or rank live deals. U.S. eCFR Part 233 deceptive-pricing guidance, FTC online-shopping and shipping guidance, current UK CMA price-transparency and GOV.UK distance-return guidance, EU prior-price/withdrawal rules, Canada Competition Bureau ordinary-selling-price guidance, Canadian online-shopping guidance, and ACCC price/refund guidance are kept market-specific rather than blended into a fake universal rule. A 2025 European Commission sweep statistic is explicitly historical, not a 2026 forecast. Browser-local tools calculate advertised vs user-verified discount, landed cost, exact-series price history, retailer-policy/statutory return-date baselines, new-vs-refurb evidence gaps and user-defined purchase thresholds. No product recommendation, legal compliance finding, live inventory, live coupon, affiliate ordering or universal return period is claimed.

Cyber Monday 2026 is kept rule-derived as Monday Nov 30 from OPM's official Thanksgiving date of Thursday Nov 26, 2026; Cyber Monday is not represented as a U.S. federal holiday or universal retailer sale window. The hub focuses on digital subscriptions rather than live deal rankings. FTC's 2026 rulemaking record is used to preserve the current U.S. boundary that the 2024 amended Negative Option Rule was vacated by the Eighth Circuit in July 2025 and the pre-2024 rule text was reinstated; the vacated click-to-cancel amendment is not presented as current federal rule text. FTC free-trial/auto-renewal consumer guidance and ROSCA remain cited without turning a pending enforcement allegation into a universal adjudicated rule. UK 2013 digital-content cancellation rules are separated from the draft 2026 subscription regulations, whose stated commencement is Jan 1, 2027 and therefore future relative to Cyber Monday 2026. EU VAT OSS/digital-withdrawal, UK digital VAT, Canadian GST/HST digital-economy rules and Australian imported-digital GST are kept jurisdiction-specific. Browser-local tools normalize promotional-to-renewal cost, compare annual vs monthly expected use, reconcile exact checkout tax/fees/FX, save renewal/cancellation evidence, and test retailer-specific price-match policy evidence. No live prices, cancellation service, universal tax rate, legal entitlement or purchase recommendation is claimed.

Boxing Day 2026 remains rule-derived as Saturday Dec 26. The hub explicitly separates actual date from observed/substitute public-holiday treatment: GOV.UK lists Monday Dec 28 as the Boxing Day substitute bank holiday; New Zealand lists Dec 26 actual and Dec 28 observed; Fair Work shows state/territory-specific Australian treatment including additional Dec 28 holidays, Tasmania's Dec 28 Boxing Day label, and South Australia's Proclamation Day wording; Canadian federal labour, CRA and Ontario rules are kept scope-specific. Public holiday is not equated with store closure: Ontario's current mandatory province-wide retail-closure list does not include Boxing Day, and UK national trading rules do not create a blanket Saturday Boxing Day closure. Return rights are kept distinct from voluntary change-of-mind policies: UK sale-item fault rights and distance cancellation, Ontario no general return/exchange right, Australian consumer guarantees vs change of mind, and New Zealand Consumer Guarantees Act vs retailer policy. Delivery planning uses seller promises and market-specific evidence rather than invented courier closures. Browser-local tools map actual/observed holidays, calculate return-policy/statutory paths, model delivery slack, save store/transit/courier evidence, and compare online-vs-in-store total costs. TTC's current 2026 Boxing Day holiday service and Auckland Transport's Oct 2026 Boxing Day rail availability are included as dated transit examples, not universal transport rules. No live store, price, courier, parcel, transit or inventory feed is claimed.
